node.title: DLI official ell=2 weight-3 relations excluded by order-1024 norm census
node.statement: All C(512,3)2^2=88,954,880 reduced signed weight-3 polynomials at order 1024 meet a 521,220-key normalized section partitioning into exactly 510 affine-Galois classes. Exact resultants have 1,329 factor records and 1,141 distinct prime roots; none below 2^256 has v_2(q-1)>=41, and the maximum is 21. Hence no official DLI production row contains a weight-3 relation at ell=2. Independent verifiers reconstruct the normalized orbit partition, certify every resultant by split-prime CRT beyond 2*3^512, and check a shared 5,608-node recursive Pocklington graph. Weights 4 through 7 at ell=2 and WCL-ZONE remain open.
